messages:
Maria: quick sync request — PM wants a single reliability dashboard that shows timeouts, 5xx, OOMs, degraded-mode activations, and fallback counts across hosted / dedicated / private. need runtime + infra metric mapping. who can help map signals?
Sam: I can take runtime. current emits: `request.latency_ms`, `response.code`, `error.count`, `fallback.invoked` and `kvcache.hit_rate`. GPU OOMs come as `process.oom` from the pod and sometimes `node.gpu_ooms`.
Zoe: infra has `router.5xx`, `router.timeout`, `k8s.pod_restarts`, and per-tenant `quota.denied` (429). note: router and runtime both produce 5xx/timeout events — we must avoid double-counting on the UI.
Leo: oncall perspective: distinguish router-level failures (upstream timeouts returning 502/504) from runtime-level timeouts where the runtime closed the connection. both should be visible but separate by default.
Anya: UX request: product wants default combined view (stacked by source) and a toggle to split by source. panels: timeseries + table of recent traces, and a rollout link next to spikes to jump to rollout control.
Sam: suggested metric taxonomy (low-cardinality tags):
```
- error.count{source="runtime", error_type="5xx", route="/generate", env="prod"}
- error.count{source="router", error_type="5xx", route="/generate", region="us-west"}
- fallback.count{source="runtime", fallback_layer="kvcache|model_variant|router_route", route="/chat"}
- degraded.activation{reason="kvcache_miss", route="/embed", model_variant="int8"}
- process.oom{level="gpu"}
```
Keep tags: source, error_type, route, region, tier. only include model/model_variant when troubleshooting.
Zoe: add `path_group` to group similar endpoints (e.g., /v1/generate, /v1/chat -> /v1/*). infra will ingest `k8s.pod_restarts` and `node.gpu_ooms` to correlate with `process.oom`. we should apply a 30s dedupe window to map OOM -> restart spikes.
Maria: question: where to count fallbacks? router-level routing fallback (e.g., route re-routed to smaller-capacity pool) vs runtime fallback (kv-cache miss or fallback model). we probably need both metrics surfaced with `fallback_layer` tag.
Leo: runtime should emit `fallback.invoked{fallback_layer="kvcache|model_variant|router_routing"}`. router emits `routing.fallback_count`. dashboard logic: by default sum per-source but provide combined view that dedups only identical error ids.
Anya: UX: default should show combined stacks but clickable legend to split by source. show rollout metadata (`rollout.id`, `rollout.tag`) and allow filtering by `rollout.id` to compare canary vs primary. add a quick-rollback action linking to rollout service.
Sam: about OOM noise: runtime GPU OOMs often trigger both `process.oom` and a pod restart. we'll use `k8s.pod_restarts` and map with `process.oom` within 30s to prevent double spikes. Sam action: add `oom.reason` label when available.
Zoe: infra will add `k8s.pod_restarts` and `node.gpu_ooms` to the telemetry ingest by Thursday. will emit schema drift alerts via telemetry pipeline.
Maria: quota/429 handling — product wants 429s categorized as "client-side rejection" separate from server errors. dashboards should exclude 429s from the 5xx error rate.
Leo: SLOs: add `slo.burn{route=..., slo="p95<200ms"}` metric. want a derived panel showing SLO burn and error rate side-by-side.
Sam: rollout tagging: runtime will attach `rollout.id` and `rollout.tag` (canary/primary) to request telemetry. dashboard should allow filtering by `rollout.id` and show recent rollout metadata next to traces.
Anya: mockups: combined stacked timeseries, source-split toggle, table of last 20 errors with trace link, and a rollout button on each error row. will deliver by Monday.
Zoe: infra requests an instrumentation checklist for runtime labels to avoid high-cardinality explosions. Sam please PR a brief spec.
Sam: sample queries to prototype panels (PromQL-like):
```
sum by(route, source, error_type)(increase(error_count[15m]))
sum by(route)(increase(fallback_count[1h]))
sum by(route)(increase(process_oom[1d]))
100 * sum(increase(error_count{error_type!~"429|4xx"}[15m])) / sum(increase(request_count[15m]))
```
Note: exclude 429 from error rate. use `increase(...)` windows for smoothing.
Leo: also want `degraded.latency_delta{route=...}` to measure latency impact when degraded mode is active — owner: Sam.
Maria: alerts: Zoe propose alert `combined error rate > 5% for 10m` to page oncall. fine?
Zoe: yes, will add that alert with a notification playbook linking to rollback steps.
Maria: action items recap:
- Sam: PR mapping doc (prom metrics -> dashboard panels) by EOD Wednesday.
- Zoe: ingest `k8s.pod_restarts` and `node.gpu_ooms` by Thursday; add alert for schema drift.
- Leo: write dedupe/aggregation rules doc (how to separate router vs runtime vs combined) by Friday.
- Anya: dashboard mockups + rollout-action UX by Monday.
- Everyone: add any missing metrics to the telemetry checklist thread.
infra-bot: (deployment) telemetry-ingest-config updated in staging; watch for schema drift alerts.
Maria: thanks all. marking owners in the ticket and we'll reconvene next Tuesday. :thumbsup: if no blockers.
Leo: small follow-up — Sam please add `degraded.activation_rate` and `degraded.latency_delta` to the checklist.
Sam: will add both and include example panels.
Zoe: I'll set up a short sync with runtime engineers if there are label questions.
Maria: closing this thread for now. ping if you need an infra spike window or access to staging metrics.
